recent.text: This week, @ZachNeto25 visited Washington, D.C. to accept his 2026 Bob Feller Act of Valor Award! 🎖️ During his trip, he laid a wreath at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, took a tour of the U.S. Capitol, and was recognized in an award ceremony. An honor well earned, Zach! https://t.co/F6HikbA2ri
recent.author: Los Angeles Angels
